newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Senator Bond offers bill to aid poor areas.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Senator Bond offers bill to aid poor areas.

text.p: A bill to promote jobs in disadvantaged urban and rural areas was introduced Tuesday by Senate Small Business Committee Chairman Christopher Bond.

The HUBZone Act would provide government contracting preferences and incentives to any small business in and hiring employees from economically distressed urban or rural areas, Bond, R-Missouri, said. "My HUBZone bill will bring jobs to areas where they are needed most by setting forth incentives for small businesses to take the initiative," he said.
